TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_100.content: I'm afraid it's only a rumour, and there's no way to be certain yet. But I thought you should know.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_100.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_100.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_100

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_130.content: And for pity's sake, boy, make sure you replace that basic equipment while you're here.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_130.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_130.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_130

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_20.content: Been enjoying all the attention, have you?
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_20.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_20.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_20

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_30.content: Yes, I heard about your encounter with the Wasp Queen.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_30.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_30.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_30

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_40.content: Most of Bowerstone is talking about it. But you shouldn't let that kind of thing go to your head.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_40.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_40.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_40

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_50.content: Anyway, that's not why I called you here. You see, there are dark forces gathering that put your giant insect to shame.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_50.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_50.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_50

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_60.content: Tell me, how much do you remember of the night I took you to the Guild? Of the raid on Oakvale?
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_60.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_60.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_60

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_65.content: Not much, I wager. A most terrible night.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_65.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_65.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_65

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_70.content: I'd thought those bandits had killed your whole family. And that you were going to be next.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_70.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_70.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_70

TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_80.content: But it seems there may have been another survivor.
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_80.speaker: MAZE
TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_80.name: TEXT_CS_027_BOWERSTONE_80
